title: Adversarial Attacks on Online Handwriting using Salience-based Temporal Editing
abstract: arXiv:2607.12500v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Deep learning models for online handwriting recognition have been shown effective and are increasingly deployed in practical applications. However, their vulnerability to adversarial attacks is still a challenge. Existing adversarial methods are predominantly designed for image-based inputs and typically rely on additive spatial perturbations. When applied to online handwriting, which is inherently represented as a time series of pen trajectories, such perturbations often introduce high-frequency jitter and visibly unnatural stroke artifacts. In this work, we propose a novel adversarial attack framework for online handwriting recognition based on salience-guided temporal editing. Instead of adding noise, the proposed method generates adversarial examples by inserting and deleting points at time steps selected according to temporal salience, preserving the shape and smoothness of the original handwriting. tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于显著性引导的时序编辑对抗攻击框架，通过在时序显著性高的时间步插入和删除轨迹点（而非添加噪声扰动）来生成对抗样本，在保持原始手写形状与平滑度的同时有效攻击在线手写识别模型。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a novel adversarial attack framework for online handwriting recognition that generates adversarial examples by inserting and deleting points at temporally salient time steps—rather than adding noise—thereby preserving the shape and smoothness of the original handwriting.
